MERCHANT ROUTINE
A simple operating rhythm keeps the store reliable
textPreview: A simple operating rhythm keeps the store reliable

text: Most merchant work falls into four moments across the service day.
textPreview: Most merchant work falls into four moments across the service day.

text: Before opening
Review profile and branch details. Confirm menu prices and stock. Switch the store online only when staff can monitor orders.
textPreview: Review profile and branch details. Confirm menu prices and stock. Switch the store online only when staff can monitor orders.

text: During service
Keep sold-out items unavailable. Watch incoming orders and respond quickly when a new request appears.
textPreview: Keep sold-out items unavailable. Watch incoming orders and respond quickly when a new request appears.

text: For every order
Check options and notes. Prepare the complete package, mark it ready, and release it to the correct rider.
textPreview: Check options and notes. Prepare the complete package, mark it ready, and release it to the correct rider.

text: After service
Review completed sales, commission, and net. Update tomorrow's availability and switch the store offline when needed.
textPreview: Review completed sales, commission, and net. Update tomorrow's availability and switch the store offline when needed.
